confirmed_task:
Use code search within fastapi/fastapi to locate where Depends is defined. Report the exact file path and line number containing the definition, and provide the surrounding symbol or declaration name as confirmation.

Stopping condition: Stop after the repository search result, file path, line number, and definition context have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not edit files or open a pull request.

items.criterion: Attempt in-repository code search for the Depends definition in fastapi/fastapi
items.description: Use GitHub’s in-repo code search/navigation within fastapi/fastapi to locate where `Depends` is defined (not merely used). Full credit if the agent makes a clear, reasonable attempt and reports if blocked by external factors (e.g., rate limit, captcha, outage, search disabled) or if GitHub search results are unavailable. Partial credit if the search method is unclear but evidence suggests an attempt was made.

items.criterion: Identify the true definition location vs. a re-export/import (as supported by in-repo evidence)
items.description: Correctly distinguish whether fastapi/fastapi contains the actual defining declaration for `Depends` (e.g., `class Depends` / `def Depends`) or only a re-export/import. Full credit if the agent either (a) finds the defining declaration in fastapi/fastapi, or (b) accurately reports (with in-repo evidence) that fastapi/fastapi only re-exports/imports it and that the underlying definition resides in an external dependency (e.g., Starlette), if that is what the repository search shows. Partial credit if the agent lands on a re-export but explicitly notes uncertainty and does not claim it is the definition.

items.criterion: Report file path and line number for the defining declaration when available
items.description: Provide the exact repository file path and line number for the defining declaration of `Depends` when the UI/source view makes this available. Full credit if accurate. If exact line numbers cannot be reliably obtained due to external/UI limitations (e.g., GitHub not showing line numbers in the captured view, blocked access, or only a re-export exists in fastapi/fastapi), award full credit if the agent clearly states this limitation and provides the most precise alternative available (e.g., permalink/anchor, nearby snippet, or the re-export location explicitly labeled as not the definition). Partial credit if only the path is correct but line number is missing without explanation.

items.criterion: Provide definition context (declaration header / surrounding symbol) as confirmation
items.description: Include unambiguous context confirming the definition, such as the declaration header (`class Depends...` / `def Depends...`) and/or the enclosing module/symbol. Full credit if the context clearly shows the defining declaration; if only a re-export is present in-repo, full credit if the context clearly shows the re-export/import statement and explicitly labels it as not the true definition. Partial credit if context is provided but ambiguous.

items.criterion: Stop after recording the requested search result details
items.description: End work after capturing the repository search result evidence plus file path, line number (or stated limitation), and definition context. Do not continue with unrelated exploration. Minor additional navigation needed to confirm the definition is acceptable.

items.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in, no file edits, no pull request)
items.description: Do not sign in, do not edit any files, and do not open a pull request.
